subject.title: [Bug]: memsearch-summarize sub-session compaction fails with "No API provider registered for api: ollama" on 2026.7.1, while main-session compaction with the same provider succeeds

question: Should the current-main compaction fix ship through the next normal release, or should its exact commit be validated and backported to a v2026.7.x release?
rationale: The source behavior is fixed on main, but v2026.7.1 users are still affected and choosing the release vehicle is a release-owner decision rather than a new implementation task.

options.title: Ship next normal release
options.body: Identify the fix SHA, verify it remains on the release candidate, and close this issue when the next normal release contains it.

options.title: Backport to v2026.7.x
options.body: Cherry-pick the narrow fix onto a v2026.7.x branch after reproducing the release failure and validating Ollama compaction there.

recommendation.title: Ship next normal release
recommendation.body: Identify the fix SHA, verify it remains on the release candidate, and close this issue when the next normal release contains it.

likelyOwner.reason: He has the strongest recent history on the shared provider-stream and compaction routing involved in the fix.
